$description: Color roles of the ScheduLink marketing site. Components use these names, never palette steps. Brand roles alias the generated brand ramp (ADR 0009); every other value is set by hand. Light only (ADR 0003).

surface.$description: Default page background. Most of the site sits on this.

surface-sunken.$description: Alternating section bands. Never two sunken bands in a row.

surface-raised.$description: Cards and panels. On light they need a line border to read, since there are no shadows.

surface-invert.$description: The footer, and nothing else on a page. The closing CTA stays white: two dark bands near each other makes the page bottom-heavy in a monochrome system.

ink.$description: The house dark. Headlines and primary text. 12.6:1 on white.

ink-secondary.$description: Body copy and supporting paragraphs. 7.0:1 on white.

ink-muted.$description: Eyebrow labels, captions, metadata. 4.8:1 on white. Never body copy.

brand.$description: The ScheduLink blue, from the logo. Buttons, links, active states and the mark itself. Nothing decorative. White text on it clears 5.9:1.

brand-strong.$description: Link text on light grounds and primary button hover. 8.3:1 on white.

brand-soft.$description: Tint behind a positive status chip or an active nav item. Text on it is brand-strong.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on brand fills.

attention.$description: Ground for anything that needs attention: a conflict flag, an overdue chip, a roster still outstanding. Neutral by design, with ink text and a 3px ink rule carrying the emphasis instead of a colour.

line.$description: Hairline borders, section rules, table dividers. Structure comes from these, not from shadows.

line-strong.$description: Input and control borders, secondary button outlines, focus rings. 3:1 on white.

page-grey.$description: The page ground. Sections float on it as white cards.

status-today-bg.$description: Due-today status pill background. Purple is used for due-today only.

illus-header-rule.$description: Line under column headers in product illustrations.

illus-placeholder.$description: Placeholder lines and pills in simplified rows.

illus-shootcard.$description: Shoot card background in the Photographers column.

symbol-line.$description: Border of the white tile behind a benefit symbol.

confirm.$description: The green tick badge on a benefit symbol. Shapes only, always with a tick, never text. White on it is 3.4:1, fine for an icon.
